system.roleplaying: You have two (or more) entirely separate facets to your personality. As a result you can look at a situation from many different angles.
system.minorTwist: What perspective ended up being the wrong one for the situation?
system.majorTwist: What inner conflict has completely thrown you off?

greenAbility.name: Principle of the Split
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome a situation that benefits from having a completely new outlook and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
